engine: Reuse exact R61 BASE/OLD/V2 replay binaries and DSOs; no kernel/helper change
bottleneck: R61 counters show more first-TG misses after batched bypass; warm timing does not measure empty-pool first replay latency
selection: Planning/structured are the two prefill-admission churn cases identified by R42 and confirmed by separate R61 counters. Short512+200 is the original oversized-prefill negative control. Selected before any cold latency run; report every cell.
cold_scope: Fresh model/context/scheduler/pool for each process; common and replay warmup OFF,reps1. Driver shader and filesystem caches uncontrolled and already warmed by prior campaigns. Not a cold-start, model-loading or application TTFT measurement.
raw_gates: 48 fresh raw processes;4/variant/cell. Full emitted vectors finite/nonzero and byte-exact to first chronological cold resident AND archived R61 warm B1 at same input. Do not replace missing/failed first reference. Require actual TG triplets,first-call empty-pool counters and batched bypass on ON. All3cells must pass before timing.
timing: 48 independent no-raw/no-counter/no-profiler fresh processes;warmup0,reps1;4/variant/cell;balanced order. Fingerprints match first cold B1. PP,TG,PP+TG decode duration,TGp95;process bootstrap50000,seed63,95%CI;practical3%rates/duration,5%p95;resident drift>20%ineligible. No combine-best winner.
tradeoffs: Cold TG can worsen even if total PP+TG improves. Zero pool PP upload does not mean zero total PCIe copies; persistent payload still allocated. Single-token rule applies to batched decode too.
start: Only after all R61/R62 GPU workers join and post-run independent audits;exclusive lock,one model,MemoryMax24G,Swap2G,MemAvailable6GiB,timeout600s,disk8GiBreserve,unchangedGPU settings.
acceptance: Bounded first fixed replay only. Preserve all failed warm/long/state/fidelity gates. No general/default/M0-M3 promotion.
